about: Claim heads recognised by scripts/claims.py (docs/claim-strength.md). A conclusion head counts only when the audited declaration has exactly this defining module and kernel fingerprint (tools/Assurance.lean: type and value). tools/Assurance.lean imports every module listed here, so a same-named declaration elsewhere is a name clash. program/state are argument positions (implicit arguments included) of the computation the claim is about and of its initial state. A new head (for example codex/roadmap-batch8's TotalTripleWithin, ReturnsWithin) is added here with its fingerprint from `scripts/claims.py heads`.
